rationale: Weiru brings product marketing expertise from ByteDance's creator-focused platforms (TikTok, CapCut) directly into the consumer-AI space where Jason is building Pally.love. Jason's technical foundation in TypeScript, Python, and JavaScript pairs well with Weiru's deep experience translating complex creator-economy products into market adoption—a skill set that could strengthen how Pally.love positions itself to early users.
intro_message: Weiru @Creative Community, meet Jason Xu — he's building Pally.love in consumer-AI, and your product marketing background scaling creator platforms at ByteDance could offer valuable perspective on go-to-market strategy.
